A '''battle''' was fought between forces loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]], and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]] at [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]] during the [[Imperial Civil War]]. After the death of the warlord [[Zsinj]] in the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|battle]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], Teradoc, Rogriss, and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] moved into Zsinj's former territory to capture what they could. Teradoc secured a victory at Junction, bringing many of Zsinj's ships to his side.
